title: 第11章 悬空山第12章 悬空山－2
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 郑常的风灵根到底还是靠谱的。
这逸风潜龙诀还是练成了。
磕磕绊绊运行了三四个周天后，基本就能流畅运行了。
当天晚上一个小时的修炼，大概吸收的灵气大概是系统灵泉每天供应灵气的一半。
系统盘算着，这样下去，好像真的能赶在期限前完成突破筑基的任务。
之前她是一点不报希望的，按着郑常一点不修炼的劲头，只靠灵泉提供的灵气，别说三个月了，半年都悬。
可现在有了敖青的修为灌输，再加上每天一小时的修炼，说不定真有机会。
这个任务是支线任务里奖励最丰富的了，而且还不需要宗门条件。
只要完成了这个任务，自己的业绩应该会好看一点点。
于是乎，系统放弃了摆烂，再次劝起了郑常。
【宿主，你还是稍稍增加一下修炼时间吧。再加半个小时，怎么样？】
另一边，敖青享受到了与郑常同步修炼，也是心动。
在郑常修炼时吸收灵气，速度是之前的两倍！也就比用自己灵根吸收慢上一点了。
可郑常这小子是一点也不在意，怎么会有人体会过修为哐哐上涨后还没有兴趣修炼的呢？
“常哥啊，每天半个时辰还是太少了，至少增加到一个时辰吧。”
一蛇一系统，都在劝，郑常都无语了。
唉，怪自己心软，好好的修炼个屁修炼。每天被占用了一个小时，这些玩意还想得寸进尺？
“加个屁！你们染上修炼了！今天加一会，明天加一会，到时就要变成无情的修炼工具，007闭死关修炼了。我可不要，再提加练，现在每晚的修炼也不练了。”
郑常这话既是对系统说的又是敖青说的。
见郑常咬死不放，两人也不敢再劝，他说不练是真敢不练的。
行吧，一个小时就一个小时吧。
“好啦，看开点，早点休息，明天再走半天就能到悬空山了，你们不觉得兴奋吗？”
敖青一脸傻子的表情看着郑常。
系统也沉默不语。
“怎么了漂浮在空中的山体啊，你们见过吗？”
“唉”敖青叹了口气，“我是风龙，风龙族连茅房都是漂浮在空中的。”
【宿主你忘了，我权限不够，看不见……】
“反正老子没看过！老子要去看！老子要睡了。”郑常使出了撒泼大法，钻进了帐篷。
敖青有点无奈，只能继续盘起身子来，继续修炼。
郑常不着急，他可着急！
至少让自己恢复风龙的身体吧，这副青蛇的样子，若是让认识的人知道了，他还不如死了算了。
悬空山。
严格来说不算地名，而是地貌。
这里的全名应该叫锦城东悬空山。
修仙界的悬空山，没有一千座也有八百座了。
不少宗门还就喜欢建在这悬空山上。
修仙界甚至有悬空岛、悬空大陆的。
虽然对敖青对悬空山已经见怪不怪了，但郑常真是第一次见这种奇景。
想象中的悬空山，应该是电影里的那种几个小浮岛飘在空中的仙山，上面还有建筑植被。
content_en:
Zheng Chang's Fengling roots are still reliable.
I have finally mastered the Yifeng Hidden Dragon Technique.
After running stumblingly for three or four weeks, it can basically run smoothly.
In an hour of practice that night, the spiritual energy absorbed was probably half of the spiritual energy supplied by the system's spiritual spring every day.
The system is calculating that if this continues, it seems that it can really complete the task of breaking through the foundation building before the deadline.
Before, she had no hope at all. According to Zheng Chang's desire to not practice at all, and only relied on the spiritual energy provided by the spiritual spring, she could not wait for three months, let alone half a year.
But now with Ao Qing's indoctrination and one hour of practice every day, there might be a chance.
This task is the most rewarding among the side tasks, and it does not require sect conditions.
As long as you complete this task, your performance should look a little better.
Ever since, the system gave up on the mess and persuaded Zheng Chang again.
[Host, you should increase your training time a little. How about another half hour? 】
On the other side, Ao Qing enjoyed practicing at the same time as Zheng Chang, and was also excited.
When Zheng Chang was practicing, he absorbed spiritual energy twice as fast as before! It is a little slower than absorbing it with your own spiritual roots.
But Zheng Chang didn't care at all. How could anyone not be interested in practicing after experiencing the increase in cultivation level?
"Brother Chang, half an hour a day is still too little. At least increase it to one hour."
The snakes and the system were all trying to persuade Zheng Chang. Zheng Chang was speechless.
Alas, I blame myself for being soft-hearted and practicing as hard as I can. After being occupied for an hour every day, do you still want to take advantage of these things?
"What the hell! You are addicted to practice! If you add a little more today and a little more tomorrow, it will become a ruthless training tool. 007 will practice in seclusion. I don't want to practice more. Now I won't practice every night."
Zheng Chang said this to both the system and Ao Qing.
Seeing that Zheng Chang refused to let go, the two of them didn't dare to persuade him anymore. He really dared not to practice when he said he wouldn't practice.
Okay, just an hour.
"Okay, look around and get some rest early. Tomorrow we can reach Xuankong Mountain in half a day's walk. Aren't you excited?"
Ao Qing looked at Zheng Chang with a fool's expression.
The system was also silent.
"What's wrong with the mountain floating in the air? Have you seen it?"
"Alas" Ao Qing sighed, "I am Fenglong. Even the huts of the Fenglong clan are floating in the air."
[Host, you forgot, I don’t have enough permissions to see...]
This...
"Anyway, I haven't seen it! I want to go see it! I'm going to bed." Zheng Chang used his trick and got into the tent.
Ao Qing was a little helpless and could only continue to curl up and continue practicing.
Zheng Chang is not in a hurry, but he is!
At least let yourself recover the body of Fenglong. If people who know him like this green snake find out, he might as well die.
…
Hanging Mountain.
Strictly speaking, it is not a place name, but a landform.
The full name here should be Jincheng East Xuankong Mountain.
There are only 800 hanging mountains in the world of immortality, if not a thousand.
Many sects also like to build on this hanging mountain.
There are even suspended islands and suspended continents in the world of immortality.
Although Ao Qing was already familiar with Xuankong Mountain, this was Zheng Chang's first time seeing such a strange sight.
The imaginary hanging mountain should be the kind of fairy mountain in the movie with several small floating islands floating in the sky, with architectural vegetation on it.
